No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper mentions manual review of GPT-4o annotations but this was for quality control of automated labeling, not for evaluating generated outputs.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' ability to process long contexts using a new benchmark (ETHIC) and metric (Information Coverage). It evaluates four NLG tasks: recalling entities, summarizing sections, organizing shuffled summaries, and attributing citations. The paper uses GPT-4o extensively for both evaluation (rating summaries, calculating IC scores) and annotation. All evaluation is automated with no human evaluation of generated outputs. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and addition of specific dataset names.
